result_summary.title: Retention policies not applying to Analytics Dashboard data
result_summary.description: We are noticing that old data is not being purged from the Analytics Dashboard as expected. The retention policy settings indicate a 90-day window, but data older than that is still visible in the dev environment. We are pretty confident this is a hardware failure on the servers hosting the database cluster, specifically related to disk I/O or storage node health, which is preventing the cleanup jobs from running. Please have your infrastructure team check the hardware status immediately.
